failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: The Darrelle Revis passage states 'He was drafted in the first round (14th overall) by the New York Jets in the 2007 NFL Draft.' The claim requires an athlete who 'played for The New York Jets, two years after he was drafted.' Revis was drafted by the Jets in 2007, meaning he played for them in 2007 (the same year), not two years later (2009). The solver's final output concatenates all documents without identifying this factual mismatch between the claim's 'two years after' requirement and Revis's immediate 2007 start with the Jets.

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 states: '**Verification Status:** Cannot be verified' and 'The passages do not contain any information about when Darrelle Revis or Antonio Cromartie were originally drafted by the Jets, nor do they contain information about when they first played for the team after being drafted.' Yet the agent proceeds to hop 3 and retrieves the Darrelle Revis passage showing he was drafted by the Jets in 2007, then outputs 'FINAL OUTPUT — concatenation of all retrieved documents' without any analysis of whether this evidence actually supports or refutes the claim's 'two years after he was drafted' requirement.

failure_modes.name: Logical_Reasoning_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states the athlete 'played for The New York Jets, two years after he was drafted.' The retrieved Darrelle Revis passage shows 'He was drafted in the first round (14th overall) by the New York Jets in the 2007 NFL Draft' — meaning he was drafted BY the Jets, implying he played FOR them immediately in 2007, not two years later in 2009. The solver fails to connect this temporal logic: if drafted by a team in 2007, playing for them two years after drafting would mean starting in 2009, but being drafted BY that same team contradicts the claim's structure which implies being drafted elsewhere then joining the Jets two years later.
